annotations.description: Playing Terramorphic Expanse instead of Rakdos Carnarium is slightly suboptimal. Rakdos Carnarium would bounce the Mountain back to hand, then next turn they could replay the Mountain and play Terramorphic Expanse, cracking it for an Island. This gives them access to 3 colors (B, R, and a fetched Island) by turn 3 with Rakdos Carnarium producing BR. Alternatively, if they crack for Swamp, similar issues arise. The Terramorphic Expanse line is slightly slower in color development compared to leading with Rakdos Carnarium, which immediately provides two colors of mana and allows better sequencing of the remaining lands.

annotations.description: Playing Lotus Cobra before the land drop is correct sequencing to get the landfall trigger, but Cultivate would have been a stronger play here. Instead, they played Lotus Cobra (2 mana) and then a Forest from hand. The Lotus Cobra is a fragile 2/1 that may not survive to provide future landfall triggers. Additionally, Cultivate would thin the deck.
